mapper.sql: id, workspace_id, campaign_id, snapshot_id, origin, message_id, message_version, channel, purpose, provider_id, status, scheduled_at, started_at, completed_at, total_recipients, dispatched_count, skipped_count, failed_count, created_by_id, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM campaign_send WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO campaign_send (workspace_id, campaign_id, snapshot_id, origin, message_id, message_version, channel, purpose, provider_id, status, scheduled_at, total_recipients, created_by_id) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{campaignId}, #{snapshotId}, COALESCE(#{origin}, 'audience'), #{messageId}, #{messageVersion}, #{channel}, #{purpose}, #{providerId}, #{status}, #{scheduledAt}, #{totalRecipients}, #{createdById})
mapper.update: UPDATE campaign_send SET status = #{toStatus} WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status = #{fromStatus}
UPDATE campaign_send SET provider_id = #{providerId} WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id}
UPDATE campaign_send SET status = 'running', started_at = COALESCE(started_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'queued'
UPDATE campaign_send SET status = 'completed', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'running'

UPDATE campaign_send s SET s.total_recipients = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_delivery d WHERE d.workspace_id = s.workspace_id AND d.send_id = s.id), s.dispatched_count = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_delivery d WHERE d.workspace_id = s.workspace_id AND d.send_id = s.id AND d.status = 'dispatched'), s.skipped_count = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_delivery d WHERE d.workspace_id = s.workspace_id AND d.send_id = s.id AND d.status = 'skipped'), s.failed_count = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_delivery d WHERE d.workspace_id = s.workspace_id AND d.send_id = s.id AND d.status = 'failed') WHERE s.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND s.id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM campaign_send WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND (status IN ('queued', 'running') OR (#{triggeredSendEnabled} AND status = 'triggered' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM campaign_delivery d WHERE d.workspace_id = campaign_send.workspace_id AND d.send_id = campaign_send.id AND d.status = 'pending'))) ORDER BY id

SELECT DISTINCT workspace_id FROM campaign_send WHERE status IN ('queued', 'running') OR (status = 'triggered' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM campaign_delivery d WHERE d.workspace_id = campaign_send.workspace_id AND d.send_id = campaign_send.id AND ((#{triggeredSendEnabled} AND d.status = 'pending') OR (d.status = 'dispatching' AND d.dispatch_lease_until < UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)))))
